text002: Learn what FIRST Robotics Competition is, how its season works, and how Team V.A.N. competes.
text004:
The FIRST Robotics Competition (FRC) is an international high school engineering program. 
Every January, new game theme is announced. Teams receive a Kit of Parts, and have 6-8 weeks to design, build, program, and test their robot before traveling to compete.
From March through April, teams compete in alliance-based competitive rounds in either a district or regional model, with the ultimate goal to qualify for the FIRST Championship. There, 600 best teams compete to play on the Einstein field, the pinnacle of FRC competition.
